brand.tagline: Subsystems on the line, on the date.
brand.mission: Deliver committed airframe subsystems and flight-critical components reliably and on time so aviation customers can keep their programmes on schedule and their fleets flying.
brand.vision: Aerospace programmes where subsystem delivery is the dependable core, not the critical-path risk.
values: Flight-critical means the evidence bar is non-negotiable.
A late subsystem can ground a programme; we protect the date.
We prove readiness with data before anything is in the build.
Fleet customers plan years ahead; we keep those plans honest.
We build responsibly — safety, export control, and ISO-grade process.
brand.about: Valiant Aero is an aerospace, defense, and aviation subsystem operator. We take committed airframe-subsystem deliveries and bring them in on the building date — integrated, verified, and traceable to the part. For programmes where a missed subsystem is a schedule domino, we make delivery reliability the least anxious part of the build.
fast_facts: Fleet and programme customers on 3 continents
history: Founded near Dayton for precision aerospace work.
Won our first major airframe-subsystem programme.
Placed every committed subsystem delivery under ledger-verified evidence.
leadership: Former programme manager who runs Valiant Aero on delivery integrity.
Owns subsystem integration across all active programmes.
testimonials: Valiant Aero is the subsystem partner we can build our master schedule around.
brand.locations: Near Dayton, OH (HQ) · integration hangars and partner facilities on 3 continents
faq: How does on-time delivery work with flight certification?
Verification and certification gates are built into the schedule; our on-time evidence covers the committed delivery on the agreed date.
Yes, we hold appropriate clearances and follow export-control process at every stage.
brand.careers: Keep programmes on schedule and fleets flying: engineering, program mgmt, quality, integration.
brand.investors: Privately held. Programme-and-reliability reporting shared with defence customers under NDA.
brand.press: media@valiantaero.example — schedule, quality, and programme announcements.
brand.esg: ISO-grade process, responsible export control, engineering education partnerships.
